== Biography ==
'''John Glasgow''' was recorded in 1617 at Linlithgow. He is attached as the son of [[Glasgow-1561|John Glasgow]].<ref name="John1617">“Scotland Births and Baptisms, 1564–1950,” FamilySearch (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:X1RV-T85 : 16 September 2021), John Glesgow, 1617.</ref>

His death has not been securely identified. A Linlithgow entry dated '''14 February 1670''', previously taken as his death, gives no forename for the deceased in the index. It places '''JOHN GLASGOW''' in the '''Parents/Other details''' field instead.<ref name="Linlithgow1670">National Records of Scotland, Old Parish Registers, deaths and burials, Linlithgow, parish 668, reference 70/653, 14 February 1670; [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ Scotland's People], exact-surname Glasgow search to 1700, index extract supplied 10 September 2026. Surname GLASGOW; forename -----; Parents/Other details JOHN GLASGOW; age blank; gender U. Original image not inspected.</ref>
